styleIdentity.description: A flat, hard-edged vector-pixel aesthetic: everything is built from axis-aligned rectangles and simple triangles, no gradients, no outlines, no anti-aliased detail. Forms are read as silhouettes against banded horizontal backdrops. The camera is a straight-on 2D side view; depth comes only from layered horizontal bands and value contrast, never from perspective.

composition.background: horizontal colour bands stacked from top to bottom: dark sky band, a wide dark mid-band, then warm ground bands
composition.midground: long flat wall/silhouette strip running the full width, punctuated by a few rectangular openings and square props
composition.foreground: full-width horizontal platform strip with a repeating dashes-and-rails pattern near the bottom edge
composition.objectScale: uniform, small-to-medium, objects sit on the ground line
composition.characterScale: small, roughly one-fifth of frame height, centred in frame
composition.density: sparse — large empty wall areas, very few props, strong negative space

lighting.contrast: medium-high between bands, zero contrast within a shape
lighting.softness: hard — no soft edges, no falloff

sun.appearance: flat disc with hard inner ring

frame.appearance: thin darker edge line on a shape

character.proportions: chibi, oversized square head, short blocky body
character.silhouette: rounded-square head over a rectangular torso, two short legs
character.faceAbstraction: two dark square eyes, no nose, no mouth curve
character.clothing: boxy uniform/coat with a contrasting belt band and a small flat cap with a square badge
character.poseLanguage: front-facing idle, feet planted, arms as small side blocks

environment.terrain: flat horizontal ground line, no slope variation
environment.architecture: long featureless wall strip with punched rectangular windows and door openings
environment.props: square sign plates, a thin post with a small illuminated head, a bare table/bench block, triangular roof wedge
environment.textureDensity: very low — solid fills with at most a single internal accent shape

shapeLanguage: single triangles for roofs, mountains and peaks
detail reduced to one internal contrasting shape
constraints: Build every form from axis-aligned rectangles and plain triangles only — no curves, no gradients, no blur, no outlines except single-pixel darker edges.
Keep each shape a solid flat fill; internal detail is at most one smaller contrasting rectangle or triangle.
Depth is expressed only through stacked horizontal bands and value contrast, never through perspective, scale falloff or cast shadows.
Characters stay small relative to the frame and stand on a single flat ground line; keep silhouettes symmetric and front-facing.
Wasteland backgrounds stay sparse: wide empty wall/sky fields, only a few rectangular props punctuating them.
Small saturated plates and emissive dots must remain fully saturated flat squares/circles so chests, resources, markers and enemies read instantly against the desaturated bands.
Enemies and treasure must be distinguishable by silhouette shape alone, not by colour alone.

identity: limited desaturated palette with few saturated accents

camera.projection: no perspective, object positions read as screen-space x/y

composition.focus: single small character on central ground line
composition.edges: shapes bleed off both left and right frame edges

lighting.shading: one shadow tone per material, applied as a flat band

constraints: no outlines thicker than one unit
